dashboard.description: Akamai SIEM powered by Hydrolix dashboard for security analytics

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(reqTimeSec) as time,
count() as total
FROM ${logs}
WHERE $__timeFilter(reqTimeSec)
AND $__conditionalAll( statusCode IN (${status:sqlstring}), $status)
AND $__conditionalAll( reqHost IN (${host:sqlstring}), $host)
AND $__conditionalAll( reqMethod IN (${method:sqlstring}), $method)
AND $__conditionalAll( reqPath IN (${path:sqlstring}), $path)
AND $__conditionalAll( cliIP IN (${clientIP:sqlstring}), $clientIP)
AND $__conditionalAll( country IN (${country:sqlstring}), $country)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Total Traffic vs SIEM Traffic; du=${__user.login}'

SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) as time,
count() as total
FROM ${table}
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
AND $__conditionalAll(host IN (${host:sqlstring}), $host)
AND $__conditionalAll(method IN (${method:sqlstring}), $method)
AND $__conditionalAll(status IN (${status:sqlstring}), $status)
AND $__conditionalAll(country IN (${country:sqlstring}), $country)
AND $__conditionalAll(clientIP IN (${clientIP:sqlstring}), $clientIP)
AND $__conditionalAll(path IN (${path:sqlstring}), $path)
AND $__conditionalAll(arrayJoin(ruleMessages)  ILIKE '%${message}%', $message)
AND $__conditionalAll(arrayJoin(ruleTags) ILIKE '%${tags}%', $tags)
AND $__conditionalAll(arrayJoin(ruleActions) ILIKE '%${ruleActions}%', $ruleActions)
AND if ('${requestHeadersName:text}' = '', true, mapContainsKeyLike(requestHeaders, '%${requestHeadersName:text}%'))
AND if ('${responseHeadersName:text}' = '', true, mapContainsKeyLike(responseHeaders, '%${responseHeadersName:text}%'))
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SETTINGS hdx_query_max_execution_time=60, hdx_query_admin_comment='db=${__dashboard}; dp=Total Traffic vs SIEM Traffic; du=${__user.login}'
